notes.title: AUGUST UPDATE: Date Nanase + DLC Discounts!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! The summer is coming to an end, and we wanted to give you something to make the end of the holidays go down a little smoother. We’re glad to announce that [b]our August update is finally available!
[/b]
This update includes a [b]new guest: Nanase, sci-fi author and all-around suave tengu[/b]! Some of you may have already bumped into her at the Con, but you’ll now be able to invite her as a guest and really get to know her. Nanase comes with a [b]big surprise:[/b] a secret ending we're sure a lot of you will enjoy. Let's just say the Spicy levels are through the roof ;)[/p][p]  [/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXc9qTMpuj6vSAqZeMMzUE9RIz8y6IDPIUjyINaS0XK4RKfNzHtPxwhan0BF-tFE1tNB-emznGgAs52ulwrIkhHtmTUvShyOO49ZBtPWN1YmufsiQvI0bScV3ItnmCMO-O8LXOeSKg?key=GoAG-5VcGaqPJWgQMLLfFQ"][/img][/p][p]As part of this August update, [b]we’re also discounting all the Monster Con DLCs for the first time[/b]. They’ll enable you to unlock some new Playable Characters, with all the exclusive art that entails![/p][p][/p][p]And in case you don’t want just one DLC, you can [b]complete the entire collection with the All-Access Bundle![/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/67a81325be932390e150b56aea9a75f20f2a5139.png"][/img][/p][p]If you’re late to the party, remember you can buy the game here: [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/"][/dynamiclink]As always, we thank you all for your support. We hope this update makes you excited to go back to the con :)[/p][p]  [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/628dbecd082032b70a22c786f2b93616079aa947.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: JUNE UPDATE: New DLC + Collab Bundle + Steam Summer Sale!
notes.content:
[p]Hi everyone! We’re writing this update to announce the[b] release of our latest DLC[/b]. This time it features [b]Bradphomet and Warm Walter,[/b] two characters who made small appearances on Monster Roadtrip, but now become full-fledged Playable Characters:[/p][list][*][p][b]Warm Walter[/b] is a sleep expert whose favorite activity is catching some Zs. This big, marshmallow-faced fella loves finding the perfect spot for a quick nap, and cuddling is his love language. After his brief appearance in "Monster Roadtrip", you can now become Walter as he looks for someone who could become his little spoon.[/p][/*][*][p]But Walter's not the only "Monster Roadtrip" breakout NPC: [b]Bradphomet[/b] is a yoga instructor with supernatural deep-breathing skills, and they're both physically and morally flexible. Become Bradphomet as they look for love, even if that means damning a few people to the eternal torment of Hell. If you like stretching your body and don’t mind selling your soul to the devil, Bradphomet is literally the GOAT for you.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/717bb37c9393dab251c497b3aa4036298f4afb27.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Get the DLC here[/b]: 
[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610620/Monster_Con__Bradphomet__Warm_Walter_Playable_Character_Pack/"]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610620/Monster_Con__Bradphomet__Warm_Walter_Playable_Character_Pack/[/url] [dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3610620/Monster_Con__Bradphomet__Warm_Walter_Playable_Character_Pack/?beta=1"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Remember you can get the DLC separately, but if you don’t have the other Playable Characters,[b] you can also get all the DLCs with the All-Access Bundle DLC below: [/b][/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50938/Monster_Con_All_Access_Bundle/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Speaking of bundles, we recently collaborated with another horny dating sim, [b]Date Everything, [/b]who just launched their game to really good critical and user reviews. We’ve had the chance to play it, and we think it’ll be right up your alley.[/p][p][/p][p]If you’re still playing catch-up with us and haven’t got Monster Prom 4 yet, [b]you can get Monster Prom 4: Monster Con and Date Everything in a bundle for a discounted price. [/b]And if you already have our game, tell your friends about it![/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/54705/Date_Everything_x_Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Last but not least, [b]the Summer Sale begins today and our games are no exception[/b]: You’ll be able to get all of our games at an unprecedented price. If you like the Monster Prom franchise but you’re missing one of our games, now’s your chance to complete your set for a discounted price.[/p][p][/p][p]As always, remember you can come discuss the game with other fans & us: [url="http://discord.gg/monsterprom"]http://discord.gg/monsterprom[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]That’s all for now! We hope you have a great summer dating horny monsters and being horny monsters yourselves [b]😉[/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/5eabfd4fb1426091fd1f8d710d3a4273c4ee069c.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: MAY UPDATE: New DLC + Free Content
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We’re super happy with the reception for “Monster Prom 4: Monster Con”. And what better way to celebrate it than by having a free update only a month after launch?

Our May Update includes a [b]new guest: Faith Fernández[/b], of The Coven fame. You’ll now be able to invite her to the Con as a guest. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/278581641a819051c26d73fdbac8099c0b48b3b4.png[/img]
As if that weren’t enough, we’re also releasing a [b]new paid DLC with two brand new playable characters[/b] to choose from:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/6388c7f6d0c6bc51ce5f55e68fd012bdee9ec09c.png[/img]
[list]
[*] It was about time [b]Sadie[/b], our 24/7-stressed pizza girl, got some respite. Today's the day! She's taken a couple sick days off from her dozen-something jobs, and she's ready to have some much-needed me time.
[*] But Sadie is not alone: she's back with another "Monster Camp" fellow: [b]Moss Mann[/b]. Moss is ready to leave the NPC life and become a fully playable character. So, if you aim to live a life worth a thousand anecdotes, this might be the character for you!
[/list]
And last but not least, to make this May update complete, [b]we’re also uploading a sizable chunk of free collectibles[/b]: trading cards, backgrounds, and emoticons to customize your Steam page. Feel free to express your not-too-normal feelings with our emoticons! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/e664a2b3d74665aca3c30b1f45777308c1420099.png[/img]

The items should be available in the next few days, so keep your eyes peeled for them!

If you’re late to the party, remember you can buy the game here: 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/[/url]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/
As always, we thank you all for your support. We hope this May update makes you excited to go back to the con :)

Get ready to nerd out with new hot monsters... and be a hot, nerdy monster yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/37adb753f89576d5b9d36ed2a6fed05e2bd60112.jpg[/img]

notes.title: "Monster Prom 4: Monster Con" is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We’re beyond excited to let you know that [b]our latest game, "Monster Prom 4: Monster Con", is FINALLY OUT! [/b]

To celebrate the launch of the game, we’ve released a [b]full-length trailer [/b]you can watch here:

[previewyoutube=mP5_QWF8rI8;full][/previewyoutube]

You can finally find love at the nerdiest convention ever! "Monster Con" goes back to the classic multiplayer dating sim formula: go through absurd and funny situations as you find love among six sexy monsters! Who will you romance? The mimic who cosplays? The idol clown? Or the eldritch cutie? (There's also Liam)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/5b6d14aa5b854a0e8aec8ffdc0bebcecfe6f4632.png[/img]

The game has an official price of $15, but [b]there's a special 10% discount if you get it now![/b]

We’ve also made [b]two DLCs available[/b], which together include four fan-favorites as alternative Playable Characters: [b]Damien & Valerie, Aaravi & and Milo.[/b]

You can get each pair separately, but you can also [b]get all four with the All-Access Bundle DLC[/b] below: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/67a81325be932390e150b56aea9a75f20f2a5139.png[/img]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50938/Monster_Con_All_Access_Bundle/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/50938/Monster_Con_All_Access_Bundle/[/url]

As always, we wanted to thank you all for your incredible support over the years: we couldn’t have made this game without you all. 

Remember you can come discuss the game with other fans & us: http://discord.gg/monsterprom. 

We can’t wait to see your reactions, and we hope you have as much fun playing as we did working on our latest weird little game.

Hope you enjoy the Monster Con 😉

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/b90424eded10f2070ccd7d8fa8ea50761105483f.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Monster Prom 4: Monster Con is coming out on April 24th! (New trailer)
notes.content:
Hi everyone! We can hardly believe it, but we’re only two weeks away from the release of our next game, [b]"Monster Prom 4: Monster Con". [/b]

You heard that right: [b]we’re releasing the game on April 24th[/b]! The release date was announced in a [b]new trailer shown at the MIX Spring Game Showcase[/b], organized by Kinda Funny and Media Indie Exchange. 

The trailer teases a lot of new content for the game: characters, plots and special art, as well as the new comic mechanic that will play a significant role in the narrative. You can [b]check it all out [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pE1qBXBUVtQ]here[/url][/b]:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/1564815047fd0d086e7dcd8ee3d5b80195647024.png[/img]

In the leadup to the release, we will also be participating in the Galaxies Showcase, streaming 17th April 2025 on Twitch. You can check out all the relevant info [url=https://www.galaxiesshow.com/]here[/url]. Our trailer will be slightly different to the one we showed on the MIX, so stay tuned to see some new stuff!

And remember you can wishlist the game and play the demo [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/]here[/url]: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45005854/6d5dba3e0512c94d3087ac2fd4effb3a18a597d3.png[/img]

As always, we thank you all for your support. We're very excited to show you what we’ve been working on this past year, and we can’t wait for you to play our latest weird little game. 

See you in a couple weeks at the Monster Con 😉

notes.title: You can play the demo to "Monster Prom 4" now!
notes.content:
Chaos continues for the "Monster Prom" franchise, as we get ready for the release of "[b]Monster Prom 4: Monster Con[/b]". 

You can now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/][b]wishlist and even play the demo[/b][/url]. 
Here's the URL, just in case: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/[/url]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/][img]https://i.imgur.com/6M5ZDaV.png[/img][/url]

This new game has a main roster of 6 Romance Options, including fan-favorite Zoe and not-a-fan-favorite-but-that'd-be-too-mainstream-anyway Liam! There's also a goofy slime, a mimic who prefers to cosplay rather than fully shapeshifting, an ex-imprisoned evil overlord... and a [b]clown[/b]. 

Last year we released the first trailer. It is very likely a 2nd one releases this month (not confirmed; but still: very likely). And after that we are aiming for a release on Spring... that's mere months from now! 

As always, we wanted to say thanks for your support. We're here, making these weird little games, hoping some people find joy and wonder in them.

See you in a few months, when we release the game ;)

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2869860/Monster_Prom_4_Monster_Con/][img]https://i.imgur.com/ODHJB7i.png[/img][/url]
